Wildcard drafts and transfer plans.

FPL Harry 5 Oct · FRESH
"MY UPDATED FPL GW6 WILDCARD DRAFTS! So Many Injuries..!"

verdict. Cutting Wissa (weak data, missed pen) and Van Hecke; rules
out Isak. Core across all 4 drafts: Muharemović, Silva, Groß, Haaland,
João Pedro . Won't pay £8m for Gabriel. No GW6 captain named.

Rogers, Groß (+ probably Palmer); João Pedro, Gonzalo, Barry. Captain
Bruno (Spurs at home), Saka the alternative. Rates Rogers better value
than Palmer.

2025/26 and 0.6× 2024/25; availability overrides from the news.

bank; −4 per extra move.
